entities.summary: Xavier Jacques Mercier is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for GC Uchaud. He has previously represented Lesquin, Guingamp, Beauvais, K.V. Kortrijk, Cercle Brugge, OH Leuven, Ferencváros and RWDM.
